note: Pop-up booth stock per table and booth slot. Built 8 Nov 2026 from MAUL_Team_Roster_28OCT2026_1118.xlsx (sheet 'Team Roster': Premium exclusive shop item / Regular exclusive shop item / Exclusive Premium service). Slot N opens after week N's contest. 'source' keeps the spreadsheet wording for Zak. Premium items and services cost 1 Goolax Premium Voucher; gp prices are placeholders. Traveling Snailsmen items are left out on purpose (finale is secret). 15 Nov 2026: each week's booth also stocks the HOST mall's items (both tables), and roster items above +1 were recast as +1 with a perk (Zak: 'nothing past +1'). 17 Nov 2026 (Zak): EVERYTHING at the booths costs 1 Premium Voucher and has no resale value; week-1 gp items got a perk, loose rematch consumables became kits (`grants` = the items a purchase creates). 17 Nov 2026 later (Zak: a voucher sells for 1,500 gp, so nothing it buys may be worth less): booth Grade II weapons became Grade III, uncommon items became rare, and kits carry Potions of Superior Healing.

priceKinds.premium-service: 1 Premium Voucher (permanent effect; the DM applies it)

vendor.name: Pell Marrowmint
lines: Every pipe on this cart was tuned in a Banañon Town greenhouse. They hum back if you're nice to them.
Tryouts done? Then you've earned a little something. Ban'ton made, Ban'ton played!
Careful with the Pipes of Haunting, sweet pea. Last fella tootled them at a bake sale. Nobody bought a single scone.

items.name: Greenhouse-Tuned Pipes (Grade III focus)
items.description: Ban'ton-made pipes that work as a +1 spell focus (+1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DCs) with Overcharge upgraded: once per match, +2d6 to one spell's damage roll. They are also Pipes of Haunting (3 charges, regain 1d3 at dawn; Wisdom save DC 15 or frightened for 1 minute).
items.source: Special instrument items, like Pipes of Haunting

items.name: Fae Microbiome
items.description: Permanent: whenever a spell heals you, you always get the maximum healing.
items.source: Fae Microbiome: Always gain the max healing from spells

vendor.name: Dame Sequina Starling
lines: Welcome to the fiercest folding table in the mall, darling. Everything here has walked a runway. Twice.
The Broad Squad says hello! Well, they said 'tell them we'll see them again', but in a loving way.
Capes, lessons and a little bit of murder on the edges. That's fashion, honey.

items.name: Billowing Friendship Cape
items.description: Cape. Requires attunement. Use a bonus action to activate; requires concentration. While active, allies within 15 feet of you raise your AC by +1.
items.source: Billowing friendship: Cape. Reqs Attunement. Use bonus action to activate. Reqs. Concentration. While active, allies within 15 feet raise your AC +1

items.name: +1 Vicious Weapon (Brutal, Grade III)
items.description: A +1 weapon with Brutal upgraded: you score a critical hit on a 19 or 20, and on a crit you roll one extra weapon die. Pick the weapon type with the DM.
items.source: Vicious weapons with +2 (recast under the +1 cap, 15 Nov 2026)

items.name: Runway Lessons
items.description: Permanent: +1 Dexterity and +1 Constitution.
items.source: Runway lessons: Permanent +1 Dex, +1 Con

3.theme: Blue Tsunami pop-up (Flot) + host-mall items (Pocket Sand)

vendor.name: Burble Kettlefin
lines: Blub! Sorry, that's hello. Everything's fresh from Flot. The wands are dry, mostly.
Don't squeeze the kelp unless you mean it. It squeezes back.
Your team gave our lot a proper splashing. No hard feelings! Well, some wet feelings.

items.name: Blowkelp Wrapping
items.description: Requires attunement; wraps one weapon. It secretes a poison that adds +1d12 poison damage to your next successful strike with that weapon. You can squeeze it as a bonus action to secrete more poison; when you do, make a DC 12 Sleight of Hand check or take 1d4+1 poison damage.
items.source: Blowkelp Wrapping: Reqs Attunement, attaches to one weapon. Secretes a poison that adds +1d12 poison damage to your next successful strike with the chosen weapon. Can squeeze the blowkelp with a bonus action to secrete more poison; when pressing, must pass a DC 12 sleight of hand check or take 1d4+1 poison damage.

items.name: Wand of Polymorph (Fish Only)
items.description: A wand of polymorph that only turns its targets into fish. Burble has other wands under the counter; ask the DM.
items.source: Wand of polymorph (turns them to fish), other wands

items.name: Aqua-Aerobics
items.description: Permanent: +1 Strength and +1 Dexterity.
items.source: Aqua-aerobics: Permanent +1 STR, +1 DEX

items.name: Glyph Stamp Set
items.description: Requires attunement. One stamp of each glyph the Pocket Sand team uses. Placing a glyph takes a bonus action; glyphs behave like the team's own. You can lay one glyph of each type per long rest.
items.source: Glyph stamp set: Req's attunement. Contains one stamp of each of the glyphs we let the SBB team use. Requires bonus action to place glyph. Behave the same as the SBB glyphs; one glyph of each type can be laid each long rest.

items.name: +1 Life-Stealing Weapon (Second Wind, Grade III)
items.description: A +1 weapon with Second Wind upgraded: once per match, when you hit, heal 3d6. Smells faintly of seawater and chalk.
items.source: Life Stealing weapons with +2 (recast under the +1 cap, 15 Nov 2026)

items.name: Continued Learning Pass
items.description: Permanent: +2 Wisdom.
items.source: Continued learning pass: Permanent +2 to Wis

4.theme: No, But pop-up (Panto) + Broad Squad restock

vendor.name: Ondine Fallowmere
lines: Can I interest you in an elemental anchor? No? But... what if it were on sale? No, but it's not.
Panto weather in a box! Lightning, fire, water, earth or air. Pick one. No, but really, pick one.
The Broad Squad left a crate of touch-up flasks with me. They insisted. Loudly. In formation.

items.name: Elemental Anchor
items.description: Requires attunement. Twice per long rest, use an action to create a 25-foot radius of elemental terrain (lightning, fire, water, earth or air). Requires concentration to maintain.
items.source: Elemental Anchor: Req's attunement. Twice per long rest, can use one action to create a 25' radius of elemental terrain (lightening, fire, water, earth, air). Requires concentration to maintain.

items.name: Ring of Spell Storing
items.description: A ring of spell storing, Panto-cut.

items.name: Atmospheric Attunement
items.description: Permanent: you gain a flying speed of 15 feet.

items.name: Glam Squad Rematch Kit
items.description: A sequinned make-up case: 3 Touch-Up Flasks (Potion of Superior Healing, 8d4 + 8 HP) and 2 Setting Sprays (Potion of Resistance: pick the damage type when you drink it). Restocked for the rematch week.

5.theme: Fairrest Federation pop-up + Blue Tsunami restock + host-mall items (Moffidge)

vendor.name: Hollis Brackenfold
lines: Mind the mist, it's only a little mist. Fairrest folk breathe it for breakfast.
That collar? Any critter that wears it becomes your best friend. My last one was a badger. We still write.
Burble from Flot dropped off a few bottles for the rematch. Smelled a bit of harbour, but they work.

items.name: Friendly Collar
items.description: Requires attunement. Once per collar, win an opposed Animal Handling check to befriend an animal. It then wears this collar and acts like a familiar.
items.source: Friendly collar: Reqs attunement. Once per collar, pass an opposed animal handling check to befriend an animal. They then wear this collar and will act like a familiar.

items.name: Fairrest Special Staff (rare)
items.description: One of the Federation's rare staves: Staff of Charming, Staff of the Woodlands or Staff of Swarming Insects. Pick with the DM.
items.source: Special Staves

items.name: Mist Inhalation
items.description: Permanent: advantage on Constitution saving throws to keep concentration.
items.source: Mist Inhalation: Permanently gain advantage on constitution saves when trying to keep concentration

items.name: Flot Rematch Kit
items.description: A net bag from Flot: 2 Potions of Water Breathing and 3 Brine Bottles (Potion of Superior Healing, 8d4 + 8 HP). Restocked for the rematch week.

vendor.name: Tamsin Ratchetbloom
lines: Luckstones! Freshly tumbled in the Gok'Gok Harbor polisher. Lucky for you, lucky for me, rent's due.
The implants are Crystec certified. Little zap, big brain. Bit of a headache Thoughtsday, then nothing.
Tryouts survivors get the good stones. The others went to a pigeon. He's doing great, actually.

items.name: Tumbled Luckstone (rare)
items.description: A Toggleton-tumbled Stone of Good Luck: while attuned, +1 to ability checks and saving throws. Tumbled perk: once per match, after you roll any d20, you can roll again and use either result.
items.source: Luckstone, similar stones.

items.name: Crystec Implants
items.description: Permanent: +1 Intelligence and +1 Strength.
items.source: Crystec implants: Permanent +1 INT, +1 STR

vendor.name: Duggo Penbarrow
lines: A stall inside a stall? It's stalls all the way down, friend. That's the Market way.
Everything's negotiable. Except the prices. And the swords. And me.
Stalling sends its regards and a small invoice for the regards.

The learning pass is great. I've learned three things since breakfast. One was about sand.

vendor.name: Sister Brindle Oakhollow
lines: Blessings of both moons on you. Rosaries on the left, armour on the right, Fiefdoms crates in the back.
The Glorious Fiefdoms lads asked me to mind their shields. They paid in turnips. I accepted the turnips.
Melunian or Selunian? Silver for the night owls, gold for the early risers. Both stop a sword.

items.name: Twin Moon Rosary
items.description: Requires attunement. Once per long rest, use an action to chant: every team member within 100 feet heals 1d12 at the top of their next turn.
items.source: Twin Moon Rosary: Req's attunement. Once per long rest, use action to perform chant and give every team member within 100 ft 1d12 healing at the top of the next turn.

items.description: Moon-forged armour, Th'Tief's take on elven mithral and adamantine: +1 AC on top of the armour, and pick one: mithral (no Strength requirement, no stealth disadvantage) or adamantine (critical hits against you become normal hits). Pick the armour type with the DM.
